findings.issue: The re_login step records fresh_session, but sec.redact's key regex masks any key containing 'session'. Result: the stdout line shows "fresh_session": [REDACTED] and, worse, the persisted runs/e2e-localhost_8889.json contains a bare [REDACTED] token, so the evidence file is NOT valid JSON (json.load fails at the last step; verified). The freshness proof is therefore invisible in both outputs, and the file cannot be parsed by tooling. Same class of bug that commit 099480d fixed for the signal key.
findings.fix_hint: Rename the key (e.g. new_cookie_values / relogin_rotated) and add a test that json.loads(open(runs/e2e-*.json)) succeeds after a redacted save.

findings.issue: authed_marker.username_visible is computed on the RAW html, but the saved file has the (registered-secret) username and email masked as [REDACTED] (verified: [REDACTED] where the username shows). The file's real authed marker is the 'Log out' button; the JSON claim username_visible=true is not true of the saved artifact.
findings.fix_hint: Compute the marker on the redacted html (it will report False for username, which is the correct, safe outcome) or drop the field and rely on logout_control.

findings.issue: logout state_rotated is vacuously true when pre_cookies is empty (token held in localStorage/sessionStorage). Acceptable because signals_gone is also required, and success signals only inspect cookies, so token-in-storage sites are weakly covered. Not a regression and not hit on 8889.
findings.fix_hint: Note as known limit (shortcut comment) or add storage-key signal later.

findings.issue: CAPTCHA detection remains DOM/attribute only: a label-only challenge ('Prove you are human' next to an unnamed input) is not detected by detect_captcha. It fails safe, since fill_step/fill_login now skip any field whose name/id/label/placeholder/aria matches captcha|robot|human|challenge (verified: the input stays empty), so nothing is solved or typed into it. Shadow DOM still not pierced.
findings.fix_hint: Optional: also treat a matched CAPTCHA_FIELD on a required field as a stop reason rather than skipping it.

notes: Verdict approve: 0 blockers, 0 majors, 4 minors. All 4 round-1 majors verified fixed. TESTS: stage1 pass; pytest 73 passed in project and in a clean git-archive of HEAD 2878a89. (a) SECRET LEAK: a readonly password field with a 5s fill timeout returns {ok:false, reason:'TimeoutError: Locator.fill: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.'} and the password is absent; running __main__ --e2e with e2e() patched to raise an error whose call-log contains the password exits with only 'RuntimeError: Locator.fill: Timeout' (no traceback); a password on the first line is masked by redact because values are registered via load_env_seed. __main__.run() wraps every CLI path, e2e() has an outer try/except that appends a redacted 'error' step. (b) The csrf-cookie + error-redirect reproduction now gives ok=False (left_login_page only); is_authenticated requires logout_control or me_user. (c) CAPTCHA: captcha appearing on signup step 2 -> captcha_detected, widget untouched (touched=0), password not filled; input[name=captcha_answer] detected; captcha-like fields are skipped by fill_step and fill_login; selectors widened (name/aria/placeholder/img/badge/cloudflare + text variants); detect_captcha is called at top of each run_signup iteration and immediately before each submit click in both run_signup and fill_login, plus after login submit. Nothing interacts with a detected widget. (d) LOGOUT: with no UI control and all POST probes 404, logout returns {ok:false, reason:'no_logout_path'}; a no-op UI 'Log out' button (cookies unchanged, control still present) returns ok:false; live logout reports signals_gone and state_rotated both true. Safety carry-overs: login_once now calls check_url(login_url); account-page navigation calls check_url and runs in the guarded context; creds only from .env.test via load_env_seed. e2e skips signup when .env.test exists (re-run fixed).
